description: This file defines the 'GatewayServiceUnavailableException' class, a custom exception indicating that an API Gateway proxy service is unavailable. It includes constants, constructors, static factory methods, and a builder class for creating instances.

classes.name: GatewayServiceUnavailableException
classes.description: A final class representing an exception indicating that a proxied service is unavailable. It extends DittoRuntimeException and implements GatewayException, providing static methods for creation and a builder class.

classes.name: GatewayServiceUnavailableException.Builder
classes.description: A builder class for constructing instances of GatewayServiceUnavailableException with a fluent API, ensuring thread safety is not guaranteed.

methods.description: Creates and returns a new instance of the nested Builder class for constructing exceptions.

methods.description: Creates a GatewayServiceUnavailableException with a specified message and headers.

methods.description: Creates a GatewayServiceUnavailableException by parsing a JSON object and extracting an error message.
